summary: The layout is generally coherent but exhibits minor alignment and component overlap defects within the dialog and message scroller.

issues.title: Scroll action overlaps message bubble
issues.description: Floating scroll-to-bottom button collides with the lower message container edge.
issues.evidence: Downward arrow icon overlaps the right side of the bottom message bubble.
issues.suggestion: Increase scroller viewport bottom-right padding to clear floating controls.

issues.title: Header and actions center alignment mismatch
issues.description: Centered dialog header and footer clash with asymmetric body layout.
issues.evidence: Title and buttons are centered while body content is split into unequal columns.
issues.suggestion: Align header and footer elements consistently with body content axis.
